thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/10/2018: IDCC, XNET, MITK, LITB

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/10/2018: IDCC, XNET, MITK, LITB
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +2.70%
AAPL +0.53%
IBM +1.69%
CSCO +1.10%
GOOG +0.72%
Technology stocks were firming in late trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 Monday adding over 1.4% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also climbed more than 1.4% this afternoon.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) InterDigital ( IDCC ) rose over 1% on Monday after the mobile networking equipment company increased its stock buyback authorization by another $100 million, more than doubling the amount available for share repurchases to $187 million. The company has spent about $91.9 million to reacquire about 1.2 million shares so far during 2018, averaging about $73.25 for each share.
In other sector news:
(+) Mitek Systems ( MITK ) was 9% higher after ASG Technologies increased its acquisition offer for the software firm to $11.50 per share from $10.
(-) Xunlei ( XNET ) slipped after the digital media content company announced a strategic partnership with a China Mobile ( CHL ) subsidiary to jointly develop Internet of Things industry applications using blockchain technology.
(-) LightInTheBox Holding Co ( LITB ) dropped 7.3%. It said it closed on its acquisition of Ezbuy Holding, a Singapore-based e-commerce platform.
